name: Assistance for Area Expansion of Spice Crops
benefit: - Maximum assistance up to ₹12,000/- per hectare at 40% of the unit cost of ₹30,000/- per hectare.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant must be a farmer.
   1. The applicant must be engaged in the cultivation of spice crops, such as seed spices or rhizomatic spices.
